title: Leaking and no lids.
text: Leaking and no lids.. Well, I had high hopes for these expensive glasses. Unfortunately, they are garbage. One arrived leaking the gel into the cup inside the box. I have no clue if that stuff is toxic or not, so I threw both of them out immediately. Also, even if they work, there are no lids included!

product_metadata.title: HOST Straw and Lid Plastic Double Wall Insulated Freezable Drink Chilling Tumbler with Freezing Gel Glasses for Red and White Wine, 16 oz, Grey
features: FROSTY COLD DRINKS ARE WAITING FOR YOU! - These on-the-go travel tumblers will keep any beverage cold for hours. Just pop into the freezer for at least two hours, pour your beverage, and enjoy. This insulated pint tumbler set keeps drinks colder longer.

THE MAGIC IS IN THE GEL - The insulated plastic walls of these tumblers are filled with proprietary cooling gel. This works as a beverage chiller when frozen. Freeze for two hours to chill the tumbler gel and keep your drinks at ideal temperature.

COMFORT-GRIP SILICONE BAND FOR EASY SIPPING - The BPA-free plastic construction creates a sturdy tumbler glass that is great for outdoor use. An insulated silicone band on the base makes for comfortable handling, perfect for the outdoors! Hand wash only.

PERFECT FOR OUTDOOR USE WITH A WIDE RANGE OF DRINKS - This drinkware kit is the perfect backyard tumbler set for water, fruit juice, iced tea, cold brew coffee, beer, and more. Keep drinks chilled down, even in the sun or in the heat of the outdoors.

INNOVATIVE TRAVEL-FRIENDLY GIFT - This daily carry portable travel tumbler is a great, useful gift for gadget-loving coffee drinkers or anyone who loves staying hydrated on the go. Kitchen gadgets are rarely so useful!
description: Tumbler freeze™ cooling cup by host®
